name: Fragmentia-AI WGS paper: External DELFI cohort (FinaleDB)
description: AUC, sensitivity and specificity at the predefined cutoff on 538 public DELFI samples sequenced on another platform.

attributes.protocol: AUC, sensitivity and specificity at the predefined cutoff on 538 public DELFI samples sequenced on another platform. Cancer vs non-cancer; ichorCNA TF strata low < 3%, medium 3-5%, high > 5%; cutoff score 1.4650357 (98% specificity in training).
attributes.version: Fragmentia-AI WGS paper (Molecular Biomedicine 2026), Results P13-P21; Supplementary Table S4
limitations: Developer study: Geneseeq employees collected and sequenced the cohorts, developed the model and report every value.

Tumour-fraction strata are ichorCNA estimates, not measured fractions; the authors chose the 3% cutoff because the ichorCNA study reported 0.03 as its lower limit for detecting tumour from ULP-WGS (Results P8), so the low stratum holds cancers whose tumour fraction ichorCNA cannot resolve.
Retrospective case-control cohorts of clinically diagnosed cancers and non-cancer controls; not a screening population.
The cutoff is set at 98% specificity in the training cohort and applied unchanged; observed specificity in other cohorts differs (0.97 in the test cohort, 0.92 in the DELFI cohort).
No comparator method is evaluated on these cohorts; only Fragmentia-AI configurations are compared.
No tumour-fraction stratification; samples overlap the DELFI 2019 cohort used by other fragmentomics evidence.

The training cohort has 1,245 non-cancer controls, the same number as the ULP-WGS cohort of the Fragmentia-AI paper (Cell Reports Medicine 2026) from the same company, so the two studies may share samples; neither paper says.
